note: The title sits vacant after this — Tribulation (2009-05-24) explicitly bills Whitman's main event there as non-title "since Semi surrendered his own title (the X-TV strap) rather than putting a title on the line." No further X-Television reign is held in the held record after this point (the belt still gets defended per Turmoil in October 2009 — see the title's own epitaph — but no result for that later reign survives here).

won.source: promotions/mwe/archive/tribulation-2009-05-24.html
